item.title: Internal Stress Effects on Electrode Stability in Coin Cells with Different Assembly Configurations
item.description:
این کار با مونتاژ رباتیک سلول‌های سکه‌ای نشان می‌دهد که دو پیکربندی رایج، توزیع تنش متفاوتی در الکترود ایجاد کرده و عملکرد الکتروشیمیایی و پایداری آن را تغییر می‌دهند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using fully automated robotic assembly to systematically compare two widely used coin cell configurations (SS-P vs. SS-N), revealing how internal stress distribution differences affect electrochemical performance, electrode structure, and interphase properties. Its significance is highlighting the urgent need for standardized battery assembly protocols to ensure reproducible, comparable data across laboratories.
🏷 coin cell assembly · internal stress · electrode stability · robotic assembly · standardization

item.title: Electrochemo‐mechanical interactions in rechargeable batteries: Mechanisms, characterization, and multiscale regulation
item.description:
این مرور، برهم‌کنش‌های الکتروشیمیایی-مکانیکی در باتری‌های قابل شارژ را از سازوکار و مشخصه‌یابی چندمقیاسی تا تنظیم تنش و تخریب بررسی می‌کند.
InfoMat | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This review uniquely integrates mechanisms, advanced multiscale characterization (synchrotron methods, in situ sensors), and regulation of electrochemo-mechanical coupling across battery systems. Its novelty lies in framing mechanical effects as dual—beneficial for ion transport/kinetics and detrimental to structure—and in consolidating multiscale strategies from crystal and electrode to cell level, providing a unified framework for improving mechanical stability and long-term cycling performance.
🏷 electrochemo-mechanics · battery degradation · stress characterization · multiscale modeling · in situ sensors
